REGIONS.oasis.name: Oasis
REGIONS.oasis.blurb: Palms, cool water and shade -- and on still nights, a merchant who may not be there at all.

SECRETS.oasis.name: An urn in the spring
SECRETS.oasis.text: Sealed with wax, and cold from the water

SECRETS.oasis.name: A traveller's satchel
SECRETS.oasis.text: Left in the palms' roots -- whoever owned it never came back

PEOPLE.oasis.name: Spring-keeper Yusuf
PEOPLE.oasis.says: Drink, rest, and leave the water as you found it.

quests.name: A clean spring
quests.text: "The reeds choke the water. Cut back the palms and bring me what grows by the spring."

quests.name: The night visitor
quests.text: "A merchant comes when the moon's up, and he's gone by dawn. Buy something from him and tell me he's real."

WORKSHOPS.mirage.name: Mirage merchant
WORKSHOPS.mirage.says: You see me? Good. Not everyone does. Look quickly -- I'm gone by sunrise.
